fixes.explanation: Good guess, friend. Priests and Levites are a fair thing to think of. But for the harvest, God points somewhere else. He says to leave the fallen grapes “…for the poor and the foreigner.” (Leviticus 19:10) So those grapes stay on the ground for them. Think of it as a batch of cookies where you leave a few on the cooling rack on purpose.

A fine to the priest? Nice try, friend, but no bill shows up in this verse. God says, “You must not turn to mediums or spiritists; do not seek them out, or you will be defiled by them.” (Leviticus 19:31) The result He names is being defiled by them. I think that's a serious warning, so I'll stay with His words.

problems.problem: The general claim that priests and Levites are involved throughout the offerings goes beyond this passage and needs a supporting reference.
Saying he would take being defiled over an invoice makes light of the warning about seeking mediums and spiritists.
